extracted.name: Tomato and chilli chutney
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member edwardos99 and has not been tested by our team.
ingredient_lines: thumb-sized piece of ginger peeled and chopped
instruction_lines: Place all of your ingredients into a large, heavy-based pan and bring to a gentle simmer, stirring occasionally.
Using a handheld blender, blend all of the ingredients, but not so much that it becomes a puree.
After simmering, bring to a gentle boil so that the mixture turns dark, jammy and shiny.
Place into sterilized jars and place in the fridge for the night. Will keep for 6 weeks.
